title: Potential Energy Diagrams
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Potential energy diagram interpretation using graph values and activation energy labels. No reaction performance is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for thermochemistry, gas behavior, phase changes, and solutions
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation page opens, use the reaction-rate activity that opens directly on that exact page. Use the screen that lets you observe particle collisions or reaction progress. Change one factor at a time based on this lesson: concentration, temperature, catalyst, or activation-energy setting. Record the changed factor, what happened to collision frequency or successful collisions, the rate effect, and the evidence for Potential Energy Diagrams.
